public_rationale: The categorical economic claim is not established by the accessible evidence. Contemporaneous reporting of Midjourney profitability is a material potential counterexample, but the accessible account lacks the financial basis and full-cost detail needed to settle the chosen test. Nor would losses at selected frontier labs prove that generative AI generally cannot be viable. The technical adjective limited supplies no separate threshold.
limitations: The assessment does not equate missing financial disclosures with losses.
The Midjourney evidence is secondary reporting; the original interview could not be read.
An industry-wide reading and a frontier-labs-only reading could yield different assessments.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI is inherently limited, impossibly expensive and economically unviable.

statement.excerpt: No matter how much you dress up whatever AI service has gaslit you into believing it’s sentient, generative AI is inherently limited, impossibly expensive and economically unviable.

from_speaker: Its services cost too much to run
its progenitors have no path to profitability
our_interpretation: The ordinary economic reading is that generative AI providers cannot sustain their services from customer receipts because costs make the business structurally unviable.
Limited and impossibly expensive are assessed through that economic proposition; having technical limitations alone does not demonstrate economic unviability.
The claim concerns generative AI generally, not only OpenAI and Anthropic.
For the ongoing observation, use January through March 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter that could have been reported before the June 8 post.
This is a technology-wide viability claim without a named company financial metric. Company-specific profit reports are relevant context but do not automatically measure the whole claim.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evidence of revenues and full operating, development and capital costs establishes structural economic unviability across generative AI services in the target period, rather than losses caused solely by expansion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible evidence establishes sustained economically viable generative AI service provision in the target period, with the relevant full costs accounted for.
